visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown-grey seal is positioned on a jagged grey rock against a blue ocean background; the seal's body exhibits rhythmic jumping movements while yellow and white text overlays appear at the top. A cartoon logo is in the top-left corner. (2) The scene transitions to a 2D animation featuring a young man with orange hair and a blue shirt in a farm setting with a red barn. A pig is shown hanging upside down; the man is knocked to the ground by a collision. Small white 'hiccup' symbols appear near his mouth. (3) A white cartoon creature with large expressive eyes and a blue scarf looks shocked. A graphic of a golden crown and the Guinness World Records logo appear centrally, accompanied by celebratory text overlays. (4) The animated man is shown in two split contexts: eating a large brown meat leg at a table and later lying in a bed with a green pillow. In both scenes, his body jerks periodically to signify ongoing hiccups. (5) The man is seen walking through an outdoor environment with green trees and simplified red buildings; his facial expression is one of worry and fatigue as he continues to hiccup. (6) A blue silhouette of a person is shown reading a book, followed by a live-action movie clip of several people in an old-fashioned office being showered with thousands of flying white letters and papers. (7) The character is depicted as an elderly man with grey hair and a red sweater standing in front of a suburban house. He looks relieved and peaceful. The video ends with a black screen and white text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 68年?!. [Slogan]: 世界上打嗝最久的人. [Logo]: 維維維. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個人打嗝了68年?!. (3) [Subtitle]: 一般我們打嗝都不超過半小時. (4) [Subtitle]: 但你能想像打嗝「59萬小時」是什麼感覺嗎?. (5) [Variety]: 啊?. [Subtitle]: 美國有個叫查爾斯·奧斯本的人. (6) [Subtitle]: Charles Osborne. (7) [Subtitle]: 28歲的一天，他在農場處理一隻約150公斤的豬. (8) [Subtitle]: 沒想到，豬太重把他撞倒在地. (9) [Subtitle]: 雖然沒什麼受傷，但他卻莫名其妙的開始了他的打嗝人生. (10) [Variety]: 嗝. [Subtitle]: 他每分鐘平均打嗝40次. (11) [Subtitle]: 後來慢慢下降至平均20次. (12) [Subtitle]: 就這樣持續了68年. (13) [Logo]: WORLD RECORDS. [Subtitle]: 創造了金氏世界紀錄. (14) [Subtitle]: 他睡覺怎麼辦啊?. [Subtitle]: 太強了吧. [Subtitle]: 一邊睡一邊打?. (15) [Subtitle]: 對，在這68年裡他學會了一邊打嗝一邊吃飯. (16) [Slogan]: 68年. (17) [Subtitle]: 一邊打嗝一邊睡覺. (18) [Subtitle]: 甚至還學會了控制呼吸節奏，降低打嗝發出的聲音. (19) [Subtitle]: 竟然有這樣的事. (20) [Subtitle]: 他的故事被媒體報出來後，查爾斯收到了4000封信. (21) [Subtitle]: 教他怎樣停止打嗝，但都沒有用. (22) [Subtitle]: 神奇的是，在他96歲時，不知什麼原因奇蹟的康復了. (23) [Subtitle]: 體驗了一年無打嗝生活後，享年97歲.
